title: Manistee garden club names Dee, John Fisk garden of the month - NewsBreak
text:
By Community Submission ,
11 hours ago Spirit of the Woods Garden Club member Linda Otto (right) presented Dee Fisk with a gift card from Our Field of Dreams in Bear Lake. Fisk is a garden of the month winner. (Courtesy of Spirit of the Woods Garden Club) MANISTEE — The Spirit of the Woods Garden Club announced Dee and John Fisk are the garden of the month winners.
The Fisks have lived in their home at 2770 River Road for 43 years. Their 5 acres are manicured with several different garden areas.
“Dee spends about six to seven hours daily in her yard and it shows. She starts all her plants by seed. Beginning in her house then moving to a beautiful greenhouse,” according to a news release.
The gardens are full of roses, varieties of bee balm, petunias, zinnias, rose of Sharon, gaura, cone flowers, lavender, ferns and much more. Some areas are shade gardens, wildflower gardens and a vegetable garden full of tomatoes, peppers, corn, blackberries and strawberries. There are many brick patios surrounded by the flowers.
“To add to the peacefulness of the yard are six running fountains, a playhouse, greenhouse and work shed as well as several ornamental trees that Dee and John planted also,” according to a news release. “(It’s) a wonderful yard to enjoy our beautiful weather.”
Spirit of the Woods Garden Club meetings are held the second Monday of the month at Oak Grove Hospitality Center, at 309 Parkdale Ave. in Manistee.
For questions about the club, contact Beth Markowski at 616-401-3387. To nominate a garden for garden of the month contact Linda Otto at Lmccg@ aol.com .
